mil5.5.10:1.2: Tathāgatena catuhi ca asankheyyehi kappānaṃ kappasatasahassena ca etth' antare sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paripācitaṃ mahato janakāyassa samuddharaṇāyāti.
mil5.5.10:1.3: Puna ca:Sabbaññutaṃ pat- tassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāyāti.
mil5.5.10:2.1: Yathā nāma bhante Nāgasena issāso vā issāsantevāsī vā bahuke divase sangāmatthāya upāsanaṃ sikkhitvā sampatte mahāyuddhe osakkeyya,
mil5.5.10:2.2: evam-eva kho bhante Nāgasena Tathāgatena catuhi ca asankheyyehi kappānaṃ kappasatasahassena ca etth' antare sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paripācetvā mahato janakāyassa samuddharaṇāya sabbaññutaṃ pattena dhammadesanāya osakkitaṃ.
mil5.5.10:3.1: Yathā vā pana bhante Nāgasena mallo vā mallantevāsī vā bahuke divase nibbuddhaṃ sikkhitvā sampatte mallayuddhe osakkeyya,
mil5.5.10:3.2: evam-eva kho bhante Nāgasena Tathāgatena catuhi ca asankheyyehi kappānaṃ kappasatasahassena ca etth' antare sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paripācetvā mahato janakāyassa samuddharaṇāya sabbaññutaṃ pattena dhammadesanāya osakkitaṃ.
mil5.5.10:4.1: Kin-nu kho bhante Nāgasena Tathāgatena bhayā osakkitaṃ, udāhu apākaṭatāya osakkitaṃ, udāhu dubbalatāya osakkitaṃ, udāhu asabbaññutāya osakkitaṃ. Kiṃ tattha kāraṇaṃ, ingha me tvaṃ kāraṇaṃ brūhi kankhāvitaraṇāya.
mil5.5.10:4.2: Yadi bhante Nāgasena Tathāgatena catuhi ca asankheyyehi kappānaṃ kappasatasahassena ca etth' antare sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paripācitaṃ mahato janakāyassa samuddharaṇāya, tena hi: sabbaññutaṃ pattassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāyāti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.5.10:4.3: Yadi sabbaññutaṃ pattassa appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya, tena hi: Tathāgatena catuhi ca asankheyyehi kappānaṃ kappasatasahassena ca etth' antare sabbaññutañāṇaṃ paripācitaṃ mahato janakāyassa samuddharaṇāyāti tam-pi vacanaṃ micchā.
mil5.5.10:4.4: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho gambhīro dunnibbedho tavānuppatto, so tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.5.10:5.1: Paripācitañ-ca mahārāja Tathāgatena catuhi ca asankheyyehi kappānaṃ kappasatasahassena ca etth' antare sabbaññutañāṇaṃ [paripācitaṃ] mahato janakāyassa samuddharaṇāya; pattasabbaññutassa ca appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya.
mil5.5.10:5.2: Tañ-ca pana dhammassa gambhīra-nipuṇa-duddasa-duranubodhasukhuma-duppaṭivedhataṃ sattānañ-ca ālayārāmataṃ sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā daḷhasuggahitatañ-ca disvā: kin-nu kho kathan-nu kho ti appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya; sattānaṃ paṭivedhacintanamānasaṃ yev' etaṃ.
mil5.5.10:6.1: Yathā mahārāja bhisakko sallakatto anekabyādhiparipīḷitaṃ naraṃ upasankamitvā evaṃ cintayati: kena nu kho upakkamena katamena vā bhesajjena imassa byādhi vūpasameyyāti;
mil5.5.10:6.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgatassa sabbakilesabyādhiparipīḷitaṃ janaṃ dhammassa ca gambhīra-nipuṇa-duddasa-duranubodha-sukhuma-duppaṭivedhataṃ disvā: kin-nu kho kathan-nu kho ti appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya; sattānaṃ paṭivedhacintanamānasaṃ yev' etaṃ.
mil5.5.10:7.1: Yathā mahārāja rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa dovārika-anīkaṭṭha-pārisajja-negama-bhaṭa-balattha-amacca-rājaññarājūpajīvine jane disvā evaṃ cittam-uppajjeyya: kin-nu kho kathan-nu kho ime sangaṇhissāmīti;
mil5.5.10:7.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Tathāgatassa dhammassa gambhīra-nipuṇaduddasa-duranubodha-sukhuma-duppaṭivedhataṃ sattānañ-ca ālayārāmataṃ sakkāyadiṭṭhiyā daḷhasuggahitatañ-ca disvā: kin-nu kho kathan-nu kho ti appossukkatāya cittaṃ nami, no dhammadesanāya; sattānaṃ paṭivedhacintanamānasaṃ yev' etaṃ.
mil5.5.10:8.1: Api ca mahārāja sabbesaṃ tathāgatānaṃ dhammatā esā yaṃ Brahmunā āyācitā dhammaṃ desenti.
mil5.5.10:8.3: Ye tena samayena manussā tāpasaparibbājakā samaṇabrāhmanā sabbe te Brahmadevatā honti Brahmagarukā Brahmaparāyanā; tasmā tassa balavato yasavato ñātassa paññātassa uttarassa accuggatassa oṇamanena sadevako loko oṇamissati okappessati adhimuccissatīti iminā va mahārāja kāraṇena tathāgatā Brahmunā āyācitā dhammaṃ desenti.
mil5.5.10:9.1: Yathā mahārāja koci rājā vā rājamahāmatto vā yassa oṇamati apacitiṃ karoti, balavatarassa tassa oṇamanena avasesā janatā oṇamati apacitiṃ karoti;
mil5.5.10:9.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja Brahme onamite tathāgatānaṃ sadevako loko oṇamissati. Pūjitapūjako mahārāja loko, tasmā so Brahmā sabbesaṃ tathāgatānaṃ āyācati dhammadesanāya, tena ca kāraṇena tathāgatā Brahmunā āyācitā dhammaṃ desentīti. -
mil5.5.10:9.3: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, sunibbeṭhito pañho, atibhadrakaṃ veyyākaraṇam, evametaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
